title: India Accepts WTO Fisheries Subsidies Agreement (123rd Member)
summary: Commerce Secretary deposits Instrument of Acceptance to curb harmful wild-capture subsidies.

blocks.content: Commerce Secretary deposits Instrument of Acceptance to curb harmful wild-capture subsidies.

items: Acceptance Milestone: India becomes 123rd WTO member to accept Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies.
Coverage Scope: Curbs subsidies for IUU (illegal, unreported, unregulated) fishing; strictly excludes aquaculture and inland fisheries.
Effective Date: Entered into force Sept 15, 2025 after 2/3rd WTO member acceptance.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: WTO Ministerial Conference (12th MC) adopted agreement in Geneva in June 2022.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Wild-capture marine fishing subsidies (covered) vs aquaculture and inland fisheries (excluded).
